excerpt.zh: 船员们对于在这个恒星系遭遇干扰的担忧是合情合理的。侦察卫星能对任何可能打乱我们行程的情况提供提前预警。
excerpt.en: Concerns about interference in this system are legitimate. A surveillance satellite will give us advance warning of anything that might disrupt our itinerary.
